_comment: Velociraptor, built to the game's 3.0 m (sim.c). Proportions are rounded from Norell & Makovicky (1999, Am. Mus. Novit. 3282) limb measurements of IGM 100/986 and Scott Hartman's skeletal reconstruction: tibia a little longer than the femur, a short metatarsus (about half the femur) as in other dromaeosaurs, a long low skull with an upturned snout, an S-curved neck and a long tail stiffened by bony rods, held nearly straight.

Velociraptor was feathered (quill knobs on the ulna, Turner et al. 2007, Science 317): the body is a smooth hull and the feathering is only suggested by streaks in the texture; there is no feather geometry. All lengths are fractions of the body length along the spine.
